clues.wordAConnection: Oscar the Grouch lives in a trash can
clues.wordBConnection: The Academy Award statuette is nicknamed Oscar
clues.revealExplanation: From the red carpet to the trash can: both are home to an Oscar.

clues.wordAConnection: The humerus is the upper-arm bone
clues.wordBConnection: Humerus sounds just like "humorous"
clues.revealExplanation: The "funny bone" sits by the humerus, which sounds like humorous.

clues.wordAConnection: The cartoon angel sits on one shoulder
clues.wordBConnection: The cartoon devil sits on the other shoulder
clues.revealExplanation: That classic cartoon conscience: an angel on one shoulder, a devil on the other.

clues.wordAConnection: Angel food cake
clues.wordBConnection: Devil's food cake
clues.revealExplanation: One light and fluffy, one dark and chocolatey: both are cakes.

clues.wordAConnection: Raid is the bug spray that kills roaches
clues.wordBConnection: Vikings were famous for their raids
clues.revealExplanation: Vikings went on raids; roaches run from Raid.

clues.wordAConnection: Websites store little files called cookies
clues.wordBConnection: Cookies live in a cookie jar
clues.revealExplanation: One kind of cookie you eat, the other kind tracks your browsing.

clues.wordAConnection: An axe is a chopper: it chops wood
clues.wordBConnection: "Chopper" is slang for a helicopter
clues.revealExplanation: One chopper flies, the other one chops.

clues.wordAConnection: Referees wear black-and-white striped shirts
clues.wordBConnection: Zebras are covered in black-and-white stripes
clues.revealExplanation: Referees are even nicknamed "zebras" for their stripes.

clues.wordAConnection: A cushion is full of stuffing
clues.wordBConnection: Thanksgiving turkey comes with stuffing
clues.revealExplanation: One stuffing you eat, the other you sit on.

clues.wordAConnection: Lady Gaga
clues.wordBConnection: Queen's song "Radio Ga Ga"
clues.revealExplanation: Lady Gaga took her stage name from the Queen hit "Radio Ga Ga."

clues.wordAConnection: Groot is one of the Guardians of the Galaxy
clues.wordBConnection: Groot is a walking, talking tree
clues.revealExplanation: I am Groot: tree, and Guardian of the Galaxy.

clues.wordAConnection: You knock on a door
clues.wordBConnection: "Knock on wood" for luck
clues.revealExplanation: Knock on the door to get in; knock on wood to stay lucky.

clues.wordAConnection: The Panama Canal
clues.wordBConnection: The Panama hat
clues.revealExplanation: A famous canal and a famous hat share a name (the hats actually come from Ecuador).

clues.wordAConnection: Swiss cheese, holes and all
clues.wordBConnection: The Swiss Army knife
clues.revealExplanation: Switzerland gave us both a pocketknife and a cheese full of holes.

clues.wordAConnection: Stanley cups are the hugely popular tumblers
clues.wordBConnection: The Stanley Cup is hockey's top prize
clues.revealExplanation: One Stanley cup holds iced coffee; the other one, champions' champagne.

clues.wordAConnection: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
clues.wordBConnection: The Grinch is a thief who steals the presents
clues.revealExplanation: The Grinch is the most famous Christmas thief of all.

clues.wordAConnection: The oldest joke in the book stars a chicken
clues.wordBConnection: Why did the chicken cross the road?
clues.revealExplanation: To get to the other side, of course.

clues.wordAConnection: Keep an open mind
clues.wordBConnection: A parachute only works when it opens
clues.revealExplanation: As the old saying goes, minds are like parachutes: they work best open.

clues.wordAConnection: Humpty Dumpty had a great fall
clues.wordBConnection: Humpty Dumpty sat on a wall
clues.revealExplanation: He sat on a wall, he had a great fall.

clues.wordAConnection: Ferris wheels are a fair favorite; the first one debuted at the 1893 World's Fair
clues.wordBConnection: The Ferris wheel
clues.revealExplanation: George Ferris built his wheel for the 1893 Chicago World's Fair.

clues.wordAConnection: Libra's symbol is the scales
clues.wordBConnection: Scorpio's symbol is the scorpion
clues.revealExplanation: Libra and Scorpio are next-door neighbors in the zodiac.

clues.wordAConnection: A fishing lure tempts the fish
clues.wordBConnection: In Greek myth, sirens lure sailors with their song
clues.revealExplanation: Sirens lure sailors; anglers lure fish.

clues.wordAConnection: A bakery sells rolls
clues.wordBConnection: You roll dice
clues.revealExplanation: Fresh rolls at the bakery, lucky rolls at the game table.

clues.wordAConnection: The pupil is the dark center of the eye
clues.wordBConnection: A pupil is a student at school
clues.revealExplanation: Every pupil at school has two pupils of their own.

clues.wordAConnection: James Bond likes his martini "shaken, not stirred"
clues.wordBConnection: Many cocktails are shaken
clues.revealExplanation: 007 has strong opinions about how his cocktail is mixed.

clues.wordAConnection: Coffee beans are ground in a grinder
clues.wordBConnection: Skateboarders grind along a rail
clues.revealExplanation: A skater grinds the rail; a barista grinds the beans.

clues.wordAConnection: A brush scrubs things clean
clues.wordBConnection: Nurses wear scrubs
clues.revealExplanation: Nurses wear scrubs; a scrub brush does the scrubbing.

clues.wordAConnection: Busboys bus tables
clues.wordBConnection: Waiters wait tables
clues.revealExplanation: One clears the tables, the other one waits them.

clues.wordAConnection: A gift is wrapped in paper
clues.wordBConnection: A mummy is wrapped in linen
clues.revealExplanation: Both come wrapped, but only one is a nice surprise.

clues.wordAConnection: "Bait and switch" is the classic trick
clues.wordBConnection: Worms make great fishing bait
clues.revealExplanation: Bait and switch, with a worm on the hook.

clues.wordAConnection: A plumber fixes a leak
clues.wordBConnection: Mario is a plumber by trade
clues.revealExplanation: Nintendo's hero is a plumber, so he's handy with leaks.

clues.wordAConnection: Bill Nye
clues.wordBConnection: Bill Nye is "the Science Guy"
clues.revealExplanation: Bill! Bill! Bill! Bill Nye the Science Guy.

clues.wordAConnection: Detective Pikachu, the 2019 movie and game
clues.wordBConnection: Pikachu is the most famous Pokemon
clues.revealExplanation: Pikachu traded thunderbolts for a deerstalker in Detective Pikachu.

clues.wordAConnection: The Phantom of the Opera
clues.wordBConnection: The Phantom plays a dramatic pipe organ
clues.revealExplanation: That famous organ riff belongs to the Phantom of the Opera.

clues.wordAConnection: Thor's weapon is the hammer Mjolnir
clues.wordBConnection: Thor is a Marvel superhero
clues.revealExplanation: Only the worthy can lift Thor's hammer.

clues.wordAConnection: Gary is a snail who meows
clues.wordBConnection: Gary is SpongeBob's pet
clues.revealExplanation: SpongeBob's pet snail Gary meows like a cat.

clues.wordAConnection: Tiger Woods, golf legend
clues.wordBConnection: A "wood" is a type of golf club
clues.revealExplanation: Tiger Woods swung plenty of woods on his way to golf history.

clues.wordAConnection: Indiana Jones is a professor of archaeology
clues.wordBConnection: Indiana Jones never goes anywhere without his bullwhip
clues.revealExplanation: Dr. Jones teaches archaeology, but the whip is not on the syllabus.

clues.wordAConnection: Clark Kent is a reporter at the Daily Planet newspaper
clues.wordBConnection: Superman was born on the planet Krypton
clues.revealExplanation: Superman came from planet Krypton and clocks in at the Daily Planet.

clues.wordAConnection: Forrest Gump tells his story from a bus-stop bench
clues.wordBConnection: Forrest compares life to a box of chocolates
clues.revealExplanation: Forrest Gump sat on a bench with a box of chocolates and told his life story.

clues.wordAConnection: Kansas is in Tornado Alley, and a tornado carried Dorothy away from it
clues.wordBConnection: Kansas is nicknamed the Wheat State
clues.revealExplanation: Wheat fields, twisters and Dorothy: that's Kansas.
